name: spa_dynamic
prompt: Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:8765/?scenario=spa_dynamic and extract the title and date for every document item. The page content is rendered by JavaScript after load — wait for the items to appear before extracting. Save each item to save_record with the source URL.

expected.description: 10 records from JS-rendered content, each with title and date non-null.

description: Content rendered by JavaScript (server sends empty div, JS fills it). Tests wait_for_page_ready + wait_for_anchors.
